brief:
Dr. Ghassan Mustafa al-Shami, a journalist and political analyst, said Gaza continues to pay an escalating price under occupation policies rooted in killing, destruction, siege, and starvation, Shehab Wire reported. He characterized the humanitarian toll as ongoing and severe, with civilians bearing the weight of military operations and blockade measures.

Al-Shami argued that Israel is instrumentalizing the Gaza tragedy for domestic electoral advantage, turning the conflict into a political asset. He stressed the necessity of forceful international intervention to arrest the crisis and impose binding accountability on occupation authorities.
